notes:
Test build for field testing. If you're not testing, you don't need this — the live build stays as it is.

- Several backup drives of the same kind plugged in at once (e.g. three T7s) no longer confuse SafeStore: it finds the right drive wherever it's mounted
- SafeStore now keeps a copy of the transfer log in the backup folder, updated as it goes, so the drive itself records what happened
- Stop works while adding an SD card waits for uploads
- Everything from the previous test build (drone dates, cards verifying after others finish, RODE "in use by", Return to stable)
